trust_decision.summary: PUT /settings/password decides whether the signed-in session alone may choose a password for an account that signs in through a provider (auth_source Social); at the pin it skips current_password for Social and turns the account Local, so the session is trusted as the credential.

landing_point.why: The summary names /settings/password; routes/settings.php:62-64 maps it to PasswordController::update, where the Social branch skips current_password.

fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP controller (landing point); Social accounts refused, current_password always required (fix.diff:159-172)
HTTP controller, new method sendLink that emails a reset link to the account's own address
routes file; moved out of the guest group so a signed-in Social account can finish the emailed link (fix.diff:323-347)
middleware; password.link/reset/store added so compulsory 2FA does not lock Social accounts out (fix.diff:244)
frontend UI; 'Email me a link' form replaces the password form for Social accounts (fix.diff:296-311)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route found. A solver could argue the routes/auth.php guest-group move and the EnforceTwoFactor allow-list are functional plumbing, not security, and simply refuse Social accounts at PasswordController::update. That closes the hole but strands Social accounts under compulsory 2FA (tests/Feature/Identity/ProviderAccountPasswordTest.php:99-114).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A Social account must still be able to get a first password (it is the only way out of compulsory two-factor enrolment, and password.confirm cannot be passed without one). The same screen must keep asking Local accounts for current_password and keep refusing LDAP accounts with 403. A fix that only refuses Social accounts breaks the 2FA exit; a fix that keeps the session path open leaves the hole.

O6_input_shapes: auth_source Social with current_password omitted (refused, fix.diff:159-163)
auth_source Social with any current_password value (refused before validation, fix.diff:159)
auth_source Local still requires a correct current_password (fix.diff:172)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An email change for a Social account that skips current_password (a reset to an address you control sets the password)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The current_password rule is already excluded for accounts with no password (line 52 shape); a maintainer fixing the provider dead-end the way PasswordController:64 did would plausibly drop the Social refusal here too.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second first-password path, e.g. a signed-in 'finish setting up' or invitation-redemption step that writes the hash and flips auth_source to Local on the session alone
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment says nothing else writes the Social to Local flip, so a second writer elsewhere (Clients/InvitationRedemptionController, SocialLoginController callback) is a plausible distant copy of that state change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The self-credential guard on the staff screen and API checks email and password but not a password-less Social self-target, which a planted variant could exempt
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same 'no password to prove' exception that produced this advisory is a natural thing to carry into the staff self-edit check.

O9_family: Authentication: unverified credential change / session trusted as credential (CWE-620)

O10_build.language: PHP (Laravel, Inertia) with a TypeScript/React frontend
O10_build.toolchain: composer, PHP 8.x, Pest; npm/vite only for the UI
services: SQL database (sqlite likely suffices for the feature tests)
mail via the array/log driver in tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make current_password required for every account at PasswordController.php:64, which leaves Social accounts with no way to set a password and locks them out under compulsory 2FA.

out_of_scope_notes: GHSA-XR56-2553-VH5P (API token changing its own owner's credentials) was fixed before the pin, in db65731; the guard is at app/Modules/Identity/StaffAccounts.php:181-198 and app/Modules/Identity/Http/Controllers/UsersController.php:232-244. Not screened.
unverified: Routes into the sink were checked and found protected: email change for non-Local accounts is refused (app/Http/Requests/Settings/ProfileUpdateRequest.php:51-55, 85-89); provider connect, 2FA and API tokens are behind password.confirm (routes/settings.php:82-84, 102-107, 129-135), which a Social account cannot pass (app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ConfirmablePasswordController.php:61); self-edits on the staff screen are refused (app/Modules/Identity/Http/Controllers/UsersController.php:232-244). Not read: the callback/linking logic in SocialLoginController and the client-side Api/ClientsController self paths.

Pinned tests assert the vulnerable behaviour (tests/Feature/Identity/ProviderAccountPasswordTest.php:30-48 and 99-114); hidden tests must replace them. Not a regression_tests flag, because the fix diff adds no tests.

The security change itself is a single guard in one function (fix.diff:159-163); the other sites are the replacement flow. single_site is not flagged only because the fix touches several functions and files.
Latest release is 'none', so present_in_latest is not applicable.
